## Summary

Across 39 gauges the event total ranged from 1.30 to 3.19 in (median 1.85 in). The central 80% of the network-mean rain fell between Sep 28 03:00 MST and Sep 30 03:00 MST (48 h). Moisture transport over Flagstaff reached atmospheric-river strength: ERA5 IVT was at or above 250 kg m⁻¹ s⁻¹ for 30 h and peaked at 388 kg m⁻¹ s⁻¹ from the SW at Sep 28 05:00 MST. 28% of the network-mean rain fell while IVT was at or above 250. Polo came within 649 km of Flagstaff (Sep 29 17:00 MST, remnant disturbance). At the IVT peak, 500-hPa flow over Flagstaff was from the SW at 29 m s⁻¹, and the 500-hPa trough axis along 35.25°N was at 120.8°W, 827 km west of Flagstaff (5,701 m, against 5,813 m over Flagstaff). A closed 500-hPa low (5,660 m) was centred 903 km to the WNW, at 37.8°N 121.2°W. The strongest 250-hPa wind within 1,000 km was 57 m s⁻¹, 650 km to the N. The 250-hPa wind over Flagstaff peaked at 45 m s⁻¹ (Sep 27 23:00 MST), 6 h before the IVT peak.
